evidence_scope: measured metadata and source-bound KV reconciliation plus derived phase arithmetic; no weights, CUDA, provider, endpoint, or quality run

prior_errors: charged 4214 full weight streams to prefill
included inactive vision residency in text decode traffic
used rejected 0.555684 GiB primary FP8 KV instead of source-bound 0.363423228 GiB

bytes.accounting_formula: W4 active stream = packed INT4 language linears + tied BF16 head; vision and small remainder are capacity-only in text decode. W4 quantized payload = 0.5 byte/weight + 2 FP16 scale bytes/group + 0.5 packed zero-point byte/group at group 128.

kv_contract.layout: one Ada FP8 E4M3 byte per K/V scalar plus inline FP32 scale per K/V token-head; local 50 layers capped at 1024 and global 10 layers retain context
kv_contract.allocator_note: logical payload only; 16-token page-rounding and runtime workspace remain separate

capacity.interpretation: Corrected FP8-KV contract changes c32 from a BF16-KV failure to a logical-fit case; 10K c32 is allocator-sensitive. c16 has substantial logical slack.

equations.prefill_weight_wall: active_text_weight_bytes / 864e9; one weight stream per large-M prefill, not one per prompt token
equations.prefill_compute_floor: 2 * language_linear_parameters * uncached_prompt_tokens / 362.05e12; analytical L40S BF16 peak prior, not measurement

prefill_inputs.note: Prompt-cache fraction changes activation/attention work; it does not create additional full weight streams in this optimistic bound.

phase_bound.interpretation: W4 c16 clears both request-rate hurdles under this optimistic phase floor; FP8 c16 clears planning but misses the conservative hurdle by about 1.0% under the same analytical assumptions. Remaining time must cover attention, scheduler, sampling, transfers, reliability, and non-linear work.

consumer_gate.consumer: first-party AutoAWQ/AutoGPTQ Marlin WNA16 CUDA linear
consumer_gate.checkpoint_route: none; synthetic proxy only, exact target-revision W4 producer absent

branch_change.why: corrected c16/c32 capacity and phase-aware W4 c16 floor clear the economic screen while actual Marlin shape support remains source-bound

quality_boundary: The packet is not an exact checkpoint route and inherits no BF16 or community-checkpoint quality. Later execution must invoke the real pinned Marlin consumer, compare outputs/features against the exact target, and preserve raw evidence.
